### Contact form

- Endpoint: https://magical-service.zappy5.app/api/email/contact-form
- Method: POST
- Content-Type: application/json
- Fields:
  - `name` (text, required)
  - `phone` (tel, required)
  - `email` (email)
  - `service` (text)
  - `message` (textarea)
  - `privacy_consent` (checkbox, required)
